name: Diabetes (Pima)
desc: 768 women of Pima Indian heritage with clinical measurements; the target says whether the diabetes test was positive.

name: Breast cancer (Wisconsin)
desc: 699 breast tumour samples scored 1–10 on cell features under the microscope; benign or malignant. 16 values are missing.

name: Contraceptive method (cmc)
desc: 1,473 married women from Indonesia's 1987 national survey; predict the contraceptive method they use (none, long-term or short-term). Coded categories are treated as numbers.

name: Liver disorders
desc: 345 men with five blood tests; predict the number of alcoholic drinks per day (half-pint equivalents).

name: Cholesterol
desc: 303 heart-disease patients (Cleveland); predict serum cholesterol in mg/dl. 6 values are missing. Coded categories are treated as numbers.
